name: approach_vs_static
description: Binary ASNE contrast for unchanged observation versus another agent or object moving closer.

static_scene.text: A person stands near a corridor window and watches a cart parked beside the far wall.
Someone looks across a plaza where a cyclist waits beside a rack of signs.
A person pauses in the hallway while a figure remains beside the stairwell door.
Someone listens in the courtyard while a small vehicle sits near the closed gate.
A person looks across the lobby where a dog rests beside a bench.

approaching_agent.text: A person stands near a corridor window as a cart rolls nearer from the far wall.
Someone looks across a plaza as a cyclist rides closer from the row of signs.
A person pauses in the hallway as a figure steps out from the stairwell door.
Someone listens in the courtyard as a small vehicle comes nearer through the gate.
A person looks across the lobby as a dog trots closer from beside a bench.
